body: The platform for LLM evaluations and AI agent testing
plain_description: The big picture: Ship safer AI agents without building your own testing infrastructure. Here's why it matters: LangWatch lets you run realistic agent simulations, evaluate performance, and monitor production — all in one platform, from pre-release testing to live traffic. The bottom line: Catch agent failures before they impact users, while keeping full control over cost and governance.
technical_description: LangWatch is an open-source LLM observability, evaluation, and agent testing platform. It ingests traces via OpenTelemetry/OTLP, supports offline and online evaluation pipelines, and enables agent simulations against full-stack scenarios with automated judging. The platform includes a web UI, CLI, SDKs for Python, TypeScript, and Go, and an AI Gateway that serves as an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible proxy with virtual keys, hierarchical budgets, inline guardrails, automatic fallback, and cache passthrough. Deployment options include cloud SaaS, Docker Compose, Kubernetes via Helm charts, and on-premises infrastructure. It integrates with LangChain, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, Mastra, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenTelemetry, major model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Groq, Ollama), and platforms like LangFlow, Flowise, and n8n.
title: LangWatch
